summary: Independent re-verification of submission sub-mv0tmsvr-01a69cbd (228 artifacts) after phase:rework-5. I re-ran every deterministic check myself after the submission: npm test 285/285, 0 fail, 0 skipped (ev:ev-mv0tq0l1-01733147); npm run test:browser 28/28 in real Chromium at 360 and 1280 px, with the new stray-null scan executing inside auditLayout on login, incidents, draft-review, published, viewer-postmortem and incidents-empty (ev:ev-mv0tqk4d-012e452b); eccode audit 'Audit OK: 780 events, chain intact, approved artifacts unchanged' (ev:ev-mv0tr0s9-01bb1404); and, because the previous D9 evidence predates rework-5, a clean clone of HEAD 06b1ac2 plus the exact uncommitted rework-5 diff following the README (no install step, npm test 285/285, npm run seed, npm start, /api/health {"status":"ok","version":"1.0.0","schemaVersion":2}, exit 0 on SIGTERM) (ev:ev-mv0tsi32-01ac80be). All 228 submitted sha256 hashes equal the working tree (checked with my own hashing, not only the engine's), the artifact set equals .eccode/drafts/verification-artifacts.txt, and git status shows exactly the seven rework-5 files changed outside .eccode/. Security review of the change: appendAll in public/js/dom.js applies the same skip rule as h() (undefined, null, false), appends Node instances as they are and everything else through document.createTextNode, so no new HTML sink is introduced; public/js still contains no innerHTML, outerHTML or insertAdjacentHTML; the remaining native append calls in public/js receive only h() elements or strings; the journey's scan is a static page.evaluate with no interpolated input; .env.example holds only defaults from src/config.js with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and GW_SEED_PASSWORD empty and no token-shaped value, and .env stays git-ignored. The report (section 11) and checklist row describe rework-5 accurately and state that no human product owner has signed off; SCOPE.md does not make that an approval condition, and the report does not claim otherwise. Not run, by instruction: holdout evals (cap guard), full CLI tune runs and npm run test:live; rework-5 touched no src/ or eval/ file, so section 5 figures stand as measured. I did not write any of the work under review.

criteria.description: Deterministic checks pass at HEAD plus the reviewed rework-5 working tree (audit, unit/API/eval suite, real-Chromium journey at 360 and 1280 px). Verified by my own runs after the submission: npm test 285/285 (ev:ev-mv0tq0l1-01733147); test:browser 28/28, the assertNoStrayNull scan running at the top of auditLayout (journey.test.js:162) on every audited page at both viewports plus the direct calls after the incident page opens and after the fake draft renders (ev:ev-mv0tqk4d-012e452b); eccode audit OK, 780 events, chain intact, approved artifacts unchanged (ev:ev-mv0tr0s9-01bb1404).

D9: clean-checkout run verified by someone other than the author, following the README. The earlier independent run (ev:ev-mv0axnvr-014c23f5) covers the pre-rework-5 code only and the rework-5 changes are uncommitted, so I ran it again myself: fresh clone of HEAD 06b1ac2 with the exact rework-5 diff applied (sha256 of the seven files in the clone equals the submitted hashes), README Install check prints 'undefined undefined' with no node_modules, npm test 285/285 pass 0 fail (exit code checked directly, no pipe), npm run seed ok, npm start serves /api/health {"status":"ok","version":"1.0.0","schemaVersion":2}, and the node process exits 0 on SIGTERM.

D8: thresholds unchanged and met on the only unbiased holdout; deviations disclosed accurately. Rework-5 changed no file under src/, eval/ or docs/ (git status: only public/js/dom.js, three views, test/browser/journey.test.js, README.md and the new .env.example), so eval/thresholds.json, eval/holdout-runs.log, eval/usage.log and docs/eval-results.md are the artifacts already judged in rev-mv0ay7tb-010829ac and their submitted hashes match the working tree. Holdout evals, tune runs and test:live were not re-run (cap guard; no provider code touched); the figures in report section 5 stand as measured, not re-measured.

D10: every open risk is listed with its residual; no known blocking defect; record is audit-clean. The stray-'null' defect listed open at delivery is fixed at all four native-append sites and is guarded by the journey scan; .env.example closes limitation 5. Report section 11 and the checklist's rework-5 row describe the change, the gate history (rejected once on R5-1, then approved rev-mv0tfif0-015659c8) and what was not re-run accurately against the diff and the evidence store; RISK-1, 2, 10 and 14 remain listed as open with residuals in section 6, unchanged. The report states that no human product owner has signed off and claims no acceptance on anyone's behalf. Audit passes on the submitted state (ev:ev-mv0tr0s9-01bb1404); all 228 submitted hashes equal the working tree.

Security of the rework-5 change: no new injection path and no secret shipped. appendAll (public/js/dom.js:21-27) uses the same child rule as h(): skips undefined/null/false, appends Node instances as they are, and converts every other value with document.createTextNode(String(c)); it never touches innerHTML. public/js has no innerHTML, outerHTML or insertAdjacentHTML use (only the comment in dom.js forbidding it). The remaining native .append calls in public/js (statements.js:84, incident.js:118 and :232) receive only h() elements or plain strings. The regression scan in journey.test.js is a static page.evaluate function with no interpolated data. .env.example contains the 15 variables of src/config.js with defaults only; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and GW_SEED_PASSWORD are empty, no token-shaped string is present, and .gitignore still excludes .env. Verified by reading the diff and the files and by the browser journey (no console errors or failed requests).

Lesson decisions: none to judge. eccode gate show verification lists no lessonDecisionsToJudge, and the delivery-lead's handoff ho-mv0tmvhx-01eb2d35 (.eccode/drafts/handoff-verification-2.json) records lessonDecisions [] and lessonsConsulted []. Recorded here so the absence is explicit.

findings.title: No human product-owner sign-off; report says so correctly
findings.detail: Report sections 9 and 11 and the checklist's rework-5 row state that no product owner has recorded a decision on RISK-1, 2, 10, 14, the run-count deviations, the holdout history, hold3-08 or the D8 outcome, and that nothing is accepted or waived by an agent. SCOPE.md does not make such a sign-off a condition of this gate (judged already in rev-mv0ay7tb-010829ac, V1 to V4), so this is not a finding against the submission; it is recorded so the statement is carried forward unchanged and not read as an approval of those items by me.
findings.recommendation: No change to the artifacts. The delivery message should repeat the section 9 list for the product owner.

findings.title: Rework-5 changes are uncommitted; a plain clone of HEAD 06b1ac2 would not contain the fix
findings.detail: git status shows the six modified files and the untracked .env.example. My D9 run applied the exact diff to a clean clone and passes (ev:ev-mv0tsi32-01ac80be), so the delivered working tree is sound, but anyone cloning HEAD as committed gets the pre-rework-5 UI with the stray 'null' text. Section 10 and 11 of the report already name this as housekeeping for the orchestrator.
findings.recommendation: Orchestrator commits the reviewed working tree (the seven rework-5 files) so HEAD matches the approved artifacts. Not an approval condition for this gate; reviewers do not commit.

findings.title: Fallback-draft review and not-found/error states remain covered by code path only (carries R5-4)
findings.detail: The journey scans every audited page and the incident and draft-review steps, but not the fallback-draft review (T3) nor the 'Not found' and error states. I read those paths: the fallback branch yields an element through the same appendAll call (incident.js:259), and the not-found/error branches are built entirely with h(), which skips null children. No defect; the gap is on record as R5-4 in rev-mv0tfif0-015659c8.
findings.recommendation: Optional: add assertNoStrayNull after the fallback-provider generate step in the journey. Optionally record the house rule as a lesson: conditional children go through h() or appendAll, never native Element.append.
